title: Wi-Fi Game & Site Unblocker — Alternate Stealth Tunnel when 1.1.1.1 WARP Fails
subtitle: Automated network stealth utility that bypasses DPI firewalls when standard 1.1.1.1 Cloudflare WARP fails.
summary: Stealth Systems & Networking Project: A specialized low-latency networking utility engineered to act as an automated alternate stealth mode when 1.1.1.1 Cloudflare WARP drops or fails, encapsulating traffic inside MASQUE TLS-443 tunnels to unblock games and developer tools with sub-15ms ping.
about: Wi-Fi Game & Site Unblocker is a specialized network utility engineered to solve strict institutional network blocking across university campus and corporate networks. Conventional VPN handshakes (WireGuard/OpenVPN) and standard 1.1.1.1 Cloudflare WARP UDP connections often fail or get blocked by Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) firewalls. This engine acts as an automated alternate stealth mode, encapsulating game and web traffic inside MASQUE (HTTP/3 over TLS Port 443) stealth tunnels. To strict firewalls, network traffic looks completely identical to regular HTTPS web browsing with sub-15ms ultra-low ping. Features automated failover, TCP auto-tuning, and a 1-line PowerShell deployment.
usecase: Alternate stealth mode when 1.1.1.1 WARP fails, unblocking restricted games (Free Fire, Genshin, Steam), bypassing institutional DPI firewalls, and zero-latency campus stealth networking.
